motion.name: interface-effect
motion.purpose: Optional native page continuity and chart scale; reduced motion overrides it and hidden windows stop the timer.

motion.name: token-count-up
motion.purpose: Optional same-context token increases; separate from interface effects, with reduced-motion and hidden-window overrides.

narrative.overview: The owner selected charcoal surfaces, crisp typography, cyan signals and amber numerals. This is a native operating tool for Windows and macOS: exact data, clear states and direct controls lead the presentation. Preserve the transparent gauge identity while allowing users to choose their own palette, typography and desktop layout.
keyCharacteristics: Exact token totals with supporting detail kept subordinate.
Flat, compact navigation and native controls.
Ten coordinated presets with independent interface and number fonts.
Optional, bounded motion that respects reduced motion and hidden windows.
dos: Do preserve all providers, themes, font choices, window modes, transparency, exports and widget controls during visual refinements.
Do use semantic palette resources in both XAML and dynamically built controls.
Do verify native font popups, light/dark presets, narrow layouts and hidden/reduced-motion states.
Do distinguish not detected, unselected, importing, tracking, expired and unavailable states.
donts: Don't add background font downloads or continuous decorative animation.
Don't round the primary exact token count to make it fit.
Don't present account allowance as token totals, subscription credits or billing data.
Don't imply support for web conversations or account integrations that the local reports do not provide.
